findings.title: Construct the report-day boundary from calendar fields.
findings.rationale: time.Time.Truncate rounds the instant against the zero-time duration and does not truncate local calendar fields. For non-UTC locations, it can return a time other than local midnight. Use time.Date with t.Date() and t.Location(). Define the intended policy for locations where midnight is skipped or repeated. If reports use UTC days, convert to UTC explicitly and document that contract.
